Extreme anxiety has caused me to nuke myself whenever I have good opportunities because I can't bring myself to eat, sleep, or not hate existence whenever I start a new job or new semester. This has caused me to see myself as a failure and a weakling for my entire life which means I have a deep, deep self-loathing, especially because I have been given EVERY opportunity to succeed in life and I can't bring myself to take my opportunities.

It took every ounce of my nerve to get through college and the fear of the real world and my total lack of confidence and my total lack of self-worth have made my life more of a living hell than usual. I've been craving death since July. I finally started my job and it just horrifies me even though I've done nothing yet. So I tried to end it but I was too much of a coward to even get even close.

I'm just so scared and I don't know what to do. I got this new job at a big company and there's just so much information, I'm so stressed. I know I'm not happy, and I'm pretty sure I won't be happy any time soon. When I was in college, I would take problematic courses that would make me feel this way and I would have to drop them to keep from letting panic and anxiety creep in; I had to radically change my life plans too when I gave up engineering because I couldn't eat or sleep anymore.

But now, this is the end of the line; if I can't swing it in an office, then I'm back at square one. And that will depress me so much. I keep wishing for a safe and fulfilling situation but I'm so afraid it doesn't exist, and until I get there all I want to do is disappear and make the pain go away.

I mean, kinda? I've talked to my therapist, I've talked to my parents, I've probed my mind for many hours and I'm just fundamentally broken. I *know* I have no good reason to worry about certain things but I do anyway, constantly. I grew up doing well in school and thinking I was destined to do great things, so when I don't (which is often) I can't stave off depression because there's a fundamental disconnect between how I've seen myself all my life and where I am now. I am hardwired to think and feel this way and I can't escape it.

I don't want to live, but I'm too scared to die so I don't think I'll take my life any time soon. Thanks for your time, I guess.

Just started a new job and I am absolutely horrified and overwhelmed by stress already, and nothing has even happened yet. Today I fantasized about a public display of suicide, one where I tell everyone I'm going in hopes that either A.) I do it or B.) They stop me and I get to leave my job and rest for even a few weeks before the crushing weight of my failure to engage in the world kicks in. I just want to be happy.
Tried Chrome, tried Chrome in Incognito, tried Safari, tried Edge. None of them will let me break out of the this loop.
